summary: RETEST of iteration_25 RevenueCat identity fix (frontend-only, mobile viewport 390x844, public preview). CRITICAL STILL FAILING: purchase choke-point remains blocked — Confirm Free Trial shows 'Almost Ready / Preparing secure checkout' on every attempt (probed twice, 20s apart) and the purchases-js Test Store modal NEVER opens, even though POST /v1/subscribers/identify returns 201 and rcLogIn resolves. RCA of why the iter_25 fix didn't work: currentAppUserId is a MODULE-LEVEL flag; identityReady is computed in the useSubscriptionContext hook body, so mutating the flag does NOT re-render the provider. The fix's assumed re-render trigger ('logIn-triggered customer-info listener refreshes the query cache') does not produce a re-render on web — no post-logIn customer-info fetch/event is observed in console/network, and even if the listener fires, react-query structural sharing bails out because CustomerInfo is unchanged (originalAppUserId stays $RCAnonymousID, entitlements still {}). Result: identityReady stays false forever. PASS: onboarding->paywall, OTP login + identity bind (201), Restore on fresh account shows 'No Active Subscription' (retested in isolation — earlier fail was a test artifact), sign-out clears identity (fresh anonymous id, re-login rebinds — identify fired again), owner bypass (iaminamrana@gmail.com) lands on tabs with no purchase and Settings now shows server plan label 'Hera Annual' + 'Hera Premium — Active', non-premium signed-in account bounced from tabs to /subscription. PRICES: dashboard STILL returns pro.monthly=$9.99 (amount 999) and pro.annual=$79.99 (amount 7999) — verified via rcbilling products API and paywall UI; the re-upsert to $12.99/$89.99 did NOT apply (reported, not fixed, per instructions). Cold-reload entitlement persistence and post-purchase Settings plan label UNTESTED (blocked by the purchase bug).

In /app/frontend/src/lib/revenuecat.tsx keep currentAppUserId but add a tiny subscription mechanism and drive identityReady with useSyncExternalStore (or a useState in the provider set by rcLogIn/rcLogOut wrappers), e.g.: const idSubs=new Set(); rcLogIn sets currentAppUserId then idSubs.forEach(cb=>cb()); in useSubscriptionContext: const identityReady = useSyncExternalStore(cb=>{idSubs.add(cb);return()=>idSubs.delete(cb)}, ()=>currentAppUserId!==null). The purchaseMutation choke-point reading the module flag directly (line 85) is already correct — only the render-time identityReady (line 100) is stale.
After the fix, re-run the full purchase flow: Confirm Free Trial -> purchases-js modal 'Test valid purchase' -> entitlement 'pro' -> land on /(tabs) -> cold-reload persistence -> Settings plan label.

rca_of_issue: BUG (STILL OPEN after iter_25 fix): Confirm Free Trial always shows 'Almost Ready — Preparing secure checkout'; Test Store modal never opens. Reproduction: fresh account -> onboarding -> /subscription -> OTP sign-in (identify POST 201, '[RevenueCat] identity bound' logged) -> plan step -> Start Free Trial -> Confirm Free Trial (retried after 20s) -> alert every time; zero purchase network calls. RCA: iter_25 fix moved identity tracking to module-level `let currentAppUserId` set by rcLogIn, but `identityReady = currentAppUserId !== null` (revenuecat.tsx:100) is evaluated during render of useSubscriptionContext. Mutating a module variable does not schedule a React re-render, and the fix's assumed trigger — logIn firing the customer-info listener which setQueryData's the cache — does not produce one on web (no post-identify customer-info fetch/event observed in console or network; additionally react-query structural sharing would bail out because the refreshed CustomerInfo is structurally identical: originalAppUserId stays $RCAnonymousID and entitlements are still empty). So identityReady remains the stale `false` captured at mount and purchasePlan's pre-check (SubscriptionContext.tsx:175) blocks every purchase before any RC call. Mitigation: make identity reactive — useSyncExternalStore over the module flag (notify in rcLogIn/rcLogOut), or lift identity state into the provider via useState; the mutation-time choke reading the live module var (revenuecat.tsx:85) is already correct. Same flaw blocks native builds where configure() precedes logIn().
